name: Default
shortDescription: Password-protected browser and mobile interface for Hermes Agent with chat, sessions, a workspace file browser and scheduled tasks, deployed together with the Hermes Agent gateway.

alerts.message: Sign in with the generated HERMES_WEBUI_PASSWORD from the environment, then pick an LLM provider and enter its API key in the onboarding wizard or under Settings > Providers; the agent cannot answer until a provider is configured. The first start installs the agent's Python dependencies and can take several minutes before the page loads.

When upgrading the hermes-agent image, remove the hermes-agent-src volume before redeploying, otherwise the old agent code in that volume keeps masking the new image. Keep the WebUI and agent versions paired.
